findings.claim: An exact GitObject instance with an uninitialized slot receives invalid_object instead of the required shape-stage invalid_input.
findings.evidence: An instance created with object.__new__(GitObject) passes the exact-type check but has no initialized oid, kind, or data slots. Accessing obj.oid in the shape pass raises AttributeError. The public wrapper catches that as an unexpected exception and returns invalid_object. The same problem occurs with a partially initialized exact instance. This violates the specified shape/types error classification and can also defeat shape-before-bounds precedence.
findings.requestedFix: Handle absent GitObject slots explicitly during the shape pass and classify them as invalid_input, without invoking supplied methods. Add negative tests for wholly and partially uninitialized exact GitObject instances, including an otherwise valid envelope containing an oversized object to confirm shape-before-bounds precedence.
